title: My Hunger Games Videogame | (Personal Fan Passion Project)
author: Hoosierologist
selftext:
I've been working on this huge Hunger Games simulator that basically lets you experience the whole thing from the Capitol's perspective, starting with the reaping, parades, training, and interviews before everyone actually enters the arena. The tributes all have different personalities, abilities, and relationships, and they independently decide whether to fight, hide, team up, betray each other, or just try to survive, so every simulation ends up telling its own little story (in theory). You can watch it and bet/sponsor, play as a tribute, mentor someone, or take over as a Gamemaker or President and manipulate the arena, send in mutts, trigger events, or change the rules. There’s also a story mode that works like a director’s chair, where you can rewrite any scene, decide who lives and dies, and then watch your version air. I've also been building out the rest of Panem, with an interactive map, district histories, past victors, and even little minigames based on what each district actually does. It's really just been a nerdy little fan passion project for me and a lot of fun! :)  
  
*(AI transparency disclosure: I used AI to help me create and develop the game, while the lore, gameplay concepts, mechanics, creative direction, and ongoing fine-tuning have all been guided by my own input. It’s purely for personal enjoyment and not for profit. I know people have different feelings about AI-generated content, so I wanted to be upfront about its involvement rather than misrepresent how the project was made.)*
